notes.title: VIRTUE Featured in Brookhaven Lab Article!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786791/a38a8ffbd53e260cf416891b4b378191180abe3f.png[/img]

VIRTUE has been featured in an article published by Brookhaven National Laboratory! Read the full article here:

[url=https://www.bnl.gov/newsroom/news.php?a=222339]Bringing the Beautiful Data of the Electron-Ion Collider to Life[/url]

A huge thank you to the team at Brookhaven Lab for showcasing VIRTUE!

notes.title: VIRTUE 2.2.0 Update
notes.content:
VIRTUE 2.2.0 Updates:

[list]
[*]The JSON 3D model file format now supports 'sphereoid' components.
[*]Improved lighting for FBX files.
[*]Included an FBX file of the ePIC detector with a school bus next to it for scale.
[*]The fly speed in the Oculus version of VIRTUE can now be adjusted.
[*]Added a 'smooth turning' mode in the Oculus version of VIRTUE.
[*]The proper method for rendering SketchUp files is now described in the manual.
[*]Other various bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: VIRTUE 2.1.0 Update
notes.content:
VIRTUE 2.1.0 Updates:

[list]
[*] Users can now upload FBX files to be displayed in the application via TriLib 2
[*] EIC detector menagerie model has been updated with better textures, and can now be expanded
[*] The menu has been entirely redesigned to be more organized and animated
[*] More customization is available for the particles that are animated before an event
[*] Grid menu has been added to the Oculus version of VIRTUE
[*] Other minor code improvements
[*] New logo!
[/list]

notes.title: VIRTUE 2.0.1
notes.content:
VIRTUE 2.0 Updates

[list]
[*]Data and Detector JSON files have an improved format.
[*]Data file is now able to display tracks, clusters, and jets in addition to hits. The collision animation is now also customizable from this file.
[*]Detector file is now able to display 'block' components in addition to toroidal components. All detector components can be positioned and rotated independently.
[*]Name tags can be assigned to detector components.
[*]More information from the Data and Detector files can be displayed as text in the HUD.
[*]Multiple data and detector files can be uploaded simultaneously, allowing the user to swap between files in-app.
[*]The user is now able to control parameters for the camera loop, such as speed, height, and radius.
[*]The user has greater control the timing of event animations.
[*]File errors will now be displayed to the user.
[*]A pdf of the manual can be opened from within the app for the Windows and Linux versions of VIRTUE Desktop.
[/list]

VIRTUE 2.0.1 Patch Notes

[list]
[*] Resolved detector scaling bug when the user selects a unit other than "m".
[*] Added "time_scale" to the header of the Data JSON file so the user to scale the size of the detector and allow the speed of the collision animation to match it.
[*] Resolved bug that prevented the user from clearing the first event.
[*] Fixed Data/Detector JSON version check to expect "2.0.1" across all versions. Previously, the Oculus version checked for "2.0" while the others checked for "2.0.0".
[list]
